text: Godrick's soldiers include pumpkin-headed warriors whose exaggerated design reflects an aesthetic of performed, rather than genuine, strength.

The Crucible Knights predate the Erdtree's dominance and carry Crucible aspects, such as tails and wings, that the Golden Order has long tried to suppress; different variants, such as the Tail Knight and Wing Knight, express different ancient biological lineages made possible during the Crucible Age.
Death Birds are enormous feathered creatures that only appear after dark, belonging to an order of death and time that predates the Golden Order's management of death.
The Night's Cavalry are armored riders appearing only at night, tied to a knightly tradition predating the Golden Order.

The Stone Digger Troll, found in the Old Altus Tunnel, and other troll enemies belong to a tradition of giant humanoid beings that predates the Golden Order's specific social organization, and function primarily as laborers valued for their size and strength in mining operations, construction, and heavy infrastructure work.
The Crucible Knights fighting in Crumbling Farum Azula are ancient Crucible entities that predate the Lands Between's current structure and even the Erdtree itself.

Bell Bearing Hunters appear at night at the locations of wandering merchants, attacking anyone present and carrying bell bearings that let the player later buy the merchant's wares from an NPC after the hunters are defeated.
